snippet.title: Yakuza 2 Restored Trailer (PS2)
snippet.description:
NOTE: Youtube decided to disable all the links in the description, check pinned comment for downloads!

Similar to the one for the first game, Yakuza 2 Restored is a patch for the original US release of Yakuza 2 for PS2. Given that it was not dubbed and the localization was nowhere near as bad as Yakuza, it could perhaps be seen as more of an enhancement than restoration patch.

There are four versions of the patch you can choose from in the download links.

Main (no suffix in filename): Features high-quality FMVs that are optimized for playing in the 16:9 mode, with cutscene subtitles a bit higher up.

4x3: Features high-quality FMVs that are optimized for playing in the 4:3 mode, with cutscene subtitles fully in the black bars, like on the unpatched game.

Lite: Features low-quality FMVs, that are optimized for 16:9.

Lite 4x3: Features low-quality FMVs, that are optimized for 4:3.

The main 16:9 versions should work on PCSX2, PS3, and PS2 with fast access like HDD, and reportedly MX4SIO is also enough (use mode 2 in the OPL game settings to prevent slowdowns during FMVs.)

The Lite versions are intended for playing using USB or burned disc on PS2. The FMVs are severely compressed to make the game fit onto a DVD5, so avoid those versions of the patch if you have any other options.

Step-by-step patching instructions:
1) You need an ISO copy of the US version of Yakuza 2 for PS2.
2) Download DeltaPatcher and the desired patch from the links in the pinned comment, and extract the zip files.
3) Launch DeltaPatcher, under "Original file" select the original game ISO, under "XDelta patch" select the "Yakuza 2 (USA) (Restored 1.02).xdelta" patch extracted from the zip.
4) On the cogwheel icon, I highly recommend checking "Backup original file", otherwise the original ISO file will be lost in the patching process.
5) Press "Apply patch" and WAIT. Don't touch anything even if it looks like the program isn't responding. On my machine it only takes about 15 seconds to apply the patch, but your mileage may vary.
6) You should now have a new ISO with "PATCHED" in the name, that you can load up and play.
